types.name: Drag Zone
types.ini_code:
[Constants]
global persist $drag_zone_start_off_x = -1
global persist $drag_zone_start_off_y = -1

global $drag_zone_width
global $drag_zone_height

global persist $drag_zone_off_x
global persist $drag_zone_off_y

global persist $menu_offset_x
global persist $menu_offset_y

[CommandListInitDragZone]
if ($drag_zone_start_off_x != (({element.offset_x} * $scale_ref) / $res_width)) || ($drag_zone_start_off_y != (({element.offset_y} * $scale_ref) / $res_height))
	$drag_zone_start_off_x = ({element.offset_x} * $scale_ref) / $res_width
	$drag_zone_start_off_y = ({element.offset_y} * $scale_ref) / $res_height

	$drag_zone_off_x = $drag_zone_start_off_x
	$drag_zone_off_y = $drag_zone_start_off_y
endif

[CommandListDragZone]
local $drag_zone_start_drag_off_x
local $drag_zone_start_drag_off_y

local $drag_start_cursor_x
local $drag_start_cursor_y

if !$drag_zone_width
	$drag_zone_width = {element.width} * $scale_ref / $res_width
	$drag_zone_height = {element.height} * $scale_ref / $res_height
endif

if !$mouse_dragging && $mouse_held && ($cursor_x >= $drag_zone_off_x && $cursor_x <= $drag_zone_off_x + $drag_zone_width) && ($cursor_y >= $drag_zone_off_y && $cursor_y <= $drag_zone_off_y + $drag_zone_height)
    $mouse_dragging = 2

    $drag_start_cursor_x = $cursor_x
    $drag_start_cursor_y = $cursor_y

    $drag_zone_start_drag_off_x = $drag_zone_off_x
    $drag_zone_start_drag_off_y = $drag_zone_off_y
endif

if $mouse_dragging == 2 && $mouse_held
    $drag_zone_off_x = $drag_zone_start_drag_off_x + ($cursor_x - $drag_start_cursor_x)
    $drag_zone_off_y = $drag_zone_start_drag_off_y + ($cursor_y - $drag_start_cursor_y)

    $menu_offset_x = $drag_zone_off_x - $drag_zone_start_off_x
    $menu_offset_y = $drag_zone_off_y - $drag_zone_start_off_y
endif

if $mouse_dragging && !$mouse_held
    $mouse_dragging = 0
endif
{if not "V7Fallbacks":{post: global.replace('$res_width','res_width')} {post: global.replace('$res_height','res_height')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_x','cursor_x')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_y','cursor_y')}}

types.name: KeyBindToggle
DrawAllElements
DrawSelectedElements
Essentials
types.ini_code:
[Constants]
global $mouse_clicked
global $mouse_held
global $mouse_dragging

global $current_slider_val = -1
global $dragged_slider_id = -1

global $active_elem_id = -1
{if "Custom Shaped Toggle" or "Enable Directional Toggles":global $last_active_elem_id?{skip}}
global $elem_id = -1
{if "Enable Directional Toggles":global $toggle_direction}
global $menu

{if "V7Fallbacks":post run = CommandListV7FallBacks}
{if "Scale to Resolution":post run = CommandListScaleRef}
{if "Drag Zone":post run = CommandListInitDragZone}

[Present]
if $mouse_clicked > 0
	post $mouse_clicked = $mouse_clicked - 1
endif

{if "Custom Shaped Toggle" or "Enable Directional Toggles":if $active_elem_id != -1
    post $last_active_elem_id = $active_elem_id
    post $active_elem_id = -1
else
    post $last_active_elem_id = -1
endif
\n
?post $active_elem_id = -1}
post $elem_id = -1

if !$mouse_held
	$mouse_dragging = 0
	$dragged_slider_id = -1
endif

[KeyLMBClick]
condition = $menu
key = VK_LBUTTON
type = cycle
$mouse_clicked = 2

[KeyMouseHeld]
key = VK_LBUTTON
type = hold
$mouse_held = 1
{Dependencies: "Scale to Resolution"} {skip}

types.name: Scale to Resolution
types.ini_code:
[Constants]
global $ref_width  = {screen.width}
global $ref_height = {screen.height}

global $scale_w
global $scale_h
global $scale_ref

[CommandListScaleRef]
$scale_w = $res_width / $ref_width
$scale_h = $res_height / $ref_height

if $scale_w > $scale_h
    $scale_ref = $scale_h
else
    $scale_ref = $scale_w
endif
{if not "V7Fallbacks":{post: global.replace('$res_width','res_width')} {post: global.replace('$res_height','res_height')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_x','cursor_x')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_y','cursor_y')}}

types.name: PageHandling
types.ini_code:
[Constants]
global $active_page
global $max_page = {max_page}

[KeyPreviousPage]
condition = $menu
key = {key.x1}
run = CommandListPreviousPage

[KeyNextPage]
condition = $menu
key = {key2.x1}
run = CommandListNextPage

[CommandListPreviousPage]
$active_page = $active_page-1
if $active_page < 0
	$active_page = ($max_page-1)
endif 

[CommandListNextPage]
$active_page = $active_page+1

if $active_page > ($max_page-1)
	$active_page = 0
endif

types.name: Check Circle Hover
types.ini_code:
[CommandListCheckCircleHover]
$\NuraThings\Public\KeepWithinCircle\start_x = $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_x
$\NuraThings\Public\KeepWithinCircle\start_y = $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_y
$\NuraThings\Public\KeepWithinCircle\circle_size = $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\width * $res_width / $scale_ref

run = CommandList\NuraThings\Public\KeepWithinCircle\Run

local $isCursorWithinCircle = $\NuraThings\Public\KeepWithinCircle\Result

	$active_elem_id = $elem_id
endif
{if not "V7Fallbacks":{post: global.replace('$res_width','res_width')} {post: global.replace('$res_height','res_height')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_x','cursor_x')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_y','cursor_y')}}

types.name: Check Rectangle Hover
types.ini_code:
[CommandListCheckRectangleHover]
local $isCursorWithinRectangle

if ($cursor_x >= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_x && $cursor_x <= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_x + $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\width) && ($cursor_y >= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_y && $cursor_y <= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\offset_y + $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\height)
	$isCursorWithinRectangle = 1
endif

if $isCursorWithinRectangle
	$active_elem_id = $elem_id
	$isCursorWithinRectangle = 0
endif
{if not "V7Fallbacks":{post: global.replace('$res_width','res_width')} {post: global.replace('$res_height','res_height')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_x','cursor_x')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_y','cursor_y')}}

types.name: Set Slider Pos
types.ini_code:
[CommandListHandleSlider]
if $mouse_held

	if $mouse_dragging == 1 || (($cursor_x >= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_offset_x && $cursor_x <= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_offset_x + $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_width) && ($cursor_y >= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_offset_y && $cursor_y <= $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_offset_y + $\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_height))
		$current_slider_val = ($cursor_x-$\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_offset_x)/$\NuraThings\Public\Draw\last_width

		if $current_slider_val < 0
			$current_slider_val = 0
		elif $current_slider_val > 1
			$current_slider_val = 1
		endif

		$mouse_dragging = 1

		if $dragged_slider_id == -1
			$dragged_slider_id = $elem_id
		endif

		$Update_ShapeKeys = 1
	else
		$current_slider_val = -1
	endif

endif

if $mouse_dragging && !$mouse_held
    $mouse_dragging = 0
endif
{if not "V7Fallbacks":{post: global.replace('$res_width','res_width')} {post: global.replace('$res_height','res_height')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_x','cursor_x')} {post: global.replace('$cursor_y','cursor_y')}}

types.name: ShapeKeys
types.ini_code:
[Constants]
global $Update_ShapeKeys = 1
post ResourcePositionShapeKeyed = copy {PositionBuf.x1} unless_null
post run = CommandListComputeShapeKeys

[CustomShaderShapeKeys]
;**** SHAPE KEY SHADER ****
;Contributors: Cybertron, SinsOfSeven, DiXiao

cs = Mods/BufferValues/NuraThings/Shaders/ShapeKey.hlsl

dispatch = {if {Verts.x1} < 1:1?{Verts.x1}}//64, 1, 1

[CommandListComputeShapeKeys]
ResourcePositionShapeKeyed = copy {PositionBuf.x1}

cs-u5 = copy ResourcePositionShapeKeyed
cs-t50 = copy {PositionBuf.x1}

{for d_element in display_elements}
{if {d_element.type_name} == 'ShapeKey Slider':run = CommandList{d_element.name.replace(" ", "")}}
{endfor}

ResourcePositionShapeKeyed = copy cs-u5

x88 = 0

cs-u5 = null
cs-t50 = null
cs-t51 = null

$Update_ShapeKeys = 0

[ResourcePositionShapeKeyed]
{post: global.replace("re:vb0\s*=\s*Resource\w*Position","vb0 = ResourcePositionShapeKeyed")}{skip}
